title: Aspire Biopharma Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Aspire Biopharma Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the second closing of a private placement offering on April 15, 2026, raising $10,000,000 through issuance of 12,500 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock, bringing total gross proceeds from the offering to approximately $11,000,000 across two closings.
key_points: Company closed second tranche on April 15, 2026, issuing 12,500 shares of Preferred Stock for $10,000,000 in proceeds
Total offering raised approximately $11,000,000 including initial closing proceeds and $943,801 debt conversion
RBW Capital Partners served as placement agent, earning $900,000 fee
Preferred Stock is convertible at 80% of the lowest closing price over 5 trading days, subject to a floor price
Conversion is subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap, which investors may increase to 9.99% with 61-day notice
Stockholder approval obtained April 10, 2026 for conversions exceeding 19.99% of common stock
